API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIData Loss PreventionWeb DLP Rule Resource Update Rule
Web DLP Rule Resource Update Rule
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/webDlpRules/:ruleId

Updates a DLP policy rule. This endpoint is not applicable to SaaS Security API DLP policy rules.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the DLP policy rule.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

The DLP policy rule information.

id
int32

The unique identifier for the DLP policy rule.

order
int32

The rule order of execution for the DLP policy rule with respect to other rules.

protocols
string[]

The protocol criteria specified for the DLP policy rule.

Possible values: [ANY_RULE, FTP_RULE, HTTPS_RULE, HTTP_RULE]

rank
int32

The admin rank of the admin who created the DLP policy rule.

description
string

The description of the DLP policy rule.

locations
object[]
locationGroups
object[]
groups
object[]
departments
object[]
users
object[]
workloadGroups
object[]
urlCategories
object[]
dlpEngines
object[]
includedDomainProfiles
object[]
excludedDomainProfiles
object[]
severity
string

Indicates the severity selected for the DLP rule violation

Possible values: [RULE_SEVERITY_HIGH, RULE_SEVERITY_MEDIUM, RULE_SEVERITY_LOW, RULE_SEVERITY_INFO]

parentRule
int32

The unique identifier of the parent rule under which an exception rule is added.

Note: Exception rules can be configured only when the inline DLP rule evaluation type is set to evaluate all DLP rules in the DLP Advanced Settings. .

subRules
object[]
fileTypes
string[]

minSize
int32

The minimum file size (in KB) used for evaluation of the DLP policy rule.

action
string

The action taken when traffic matches the DLP policy rule criteria.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, BLOCK, ALLOW, ICAP_RESPONSE]

state
string

Enables or disables the DLP policy rule.

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

timeWindows
object[]
auditor
object
externalAuditorEmail
string

The email address of an external auditor to whom DLP email notifications are sent.

notificationTemplate
object
matchOnly
boolean

The match only criteria for DLP engines.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the DLP policy rule was last modified.

lastModifiedBy
object
icapServer
object
withoutContentInspection
boolean

Indicates a DLP policy rule without content inspection, when the value is set to true.

name
string

The DLP policy rule name.

labels
object[]
excludedGroups
object[]
excludedDepartments
object[]
excludedUsers
object[]
dlpDownloadScanEnabled
boolean

If this field is set to true, DLP scan is enabled for file downloads from cloud applications configured in the rule. If this field is set to false, DLP scan is disabled for downloads from the cloud applications.

receiver
object
zscalerIncidentReceiver
boolean

This attribute is deprecated and is no longer supported. It is replaced by the receiver attribute. Previously, zscalerIncidentReceiver was used to indicate whether the Zscaler Incident Receiver is associated with the DLP policy rule, whereas receiver is currently used to specify the DLP Incident Receiver details for any given type of the Incident Receiver.

Note: API calls using this attribute would not be successful. To ensure continued API operation, you must immediately update your configurations to use the receiver attribute in the corresponding endpoints.

zccNotificationsEnabled
boolean

If this field is set to true, Zscaler Client Connector notification is enabled for the block action triggered by the web DLP rule. If this field is set to false, Zscaler Client Connector notification is disabled.

Note: This field can be configured only if the Web DLP Violation end user notification is enabled.

dlpContentLocationsScopes
string[]

Specifies one or more content locations from the available values as a match criteria for the rule to target specific sections of a file or transaction. Matches against file metadata, actual file content (not including metadata), file name, and HTTP request body are supported. Matches vary depending on the content locations selected.

Note: This rule criteria is not applicable to DLP rules without content inspection.

Possible values: [ANY, HTTP_BODY, FILE_CONTENT, DOCUMENT_PROPERTIES, FILENAME]

Successful Operation

minSize
int32

The minimum file size (in KB) used for evaluation of the DLP policy rule.

action
string

The action taken when traffic matches the DLP policy rule criteria.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, BLOCK, ALLOW, ICAP_RESPONSE]

state
string

Enables or disables the DLP policy rule.

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

timeWindows
object[]
auditor
object
externalAuditorEmail
string

The email address of an external auditor to whom DLP email notifications are sent.

notificationTemplate
object
matchOnly
boolean

The match only criteria for DLP engines.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the DLP policy rule was last modified.

lastModifiedBy
object
icapServer
object
withoutContentInspection
boolean

Indicates a DLP policy rule without content inspection, when the value is set to true.

name
string

The DLP policy rule name.

labels
object[]
excludedGroups
object[]
excludedDepartments
object[]
excludedUsers
object[]
dlpDownloadScanEnabled
boolean

If this field is set to true, DLP scan is enabled for file downloads from cloud applications configured in the rule. If this field is set to false, DLP scan is disabled for downloads from the cloud applications.

receiver
object
zscalerIncidentReceiver
boolean

This attribute is deprecated and is no longer supported. It is replaced by the receiver attribute. Previously, zscalerIncidentReceiver was used to indicate whether the Zscaler Incident Receiver is associated with the DLP policy rule, whereas receiver is currently used to specify the DLP Incident Receiver details for any given type of the Incident Receiver.

Note: API calls using this attribute would not be successful. To ensure continued API operation, you must immediately update your configurations to use the receiver attribute in the corresponding endpoints.

zccNotificationsEnabled
boolean

If this field is set to true, Zscaler Client Connector notification is enabled for the block action triggered by the web DLP rule. If this field is set to false, Zscaler Client Connector notification is disabled.

Note: This field can be configured only if the Web DLP Violation end user notification is enabled.

dlpContentLocationsScopes
string[]

Specifies one or more content locations from the available values as a match criteria for the rule to target specific sections of a file or transaction. Matches against file metadata, actual file content (not including metadata), file name, and HTTP request body are supported. Matches vary depending on the content locations selected.

Note: This rule criteria is not applicable to DLP rules without content inspection.

Possible values: [ANY, HTTP_BODY, FILE_CONTENT, DOCUMENT_PROPERTIES, FILENAME]
